posts.headline: Yazidi factions push back on reports of a possible KDP return to Sinjar
posts.summary: KurdistanWatch flags that as reports emerge of a possible KDP return to Sinjar, several Yazidi factions have voiced strong opposition, citing the unresolved 2017 Peshmerga withdrawal and the 2022 Iraqi army operation against local Yazidi armed groups.

posts.headline: KRG PM Masrour Barzani meets Erdogan in Istanbul on energy, Development Road and the Terror-Free Türkiye process
posts.summary: Barzani's Istanbul stop covered trade, transportation and energy with Erdogan at Dolmabahce, alongside a parallel session with Energy Minister Bayraktar, in the highest-level Erbil-Ankara energy meeting since the Hormuz disruption.

posts.headline: US aerial-refuelling and reconnaissance aircraft over Iraqi airspace force civil-aviation reroutes around Baghdad
posts.summary: AMrym93884 reports US aircraft, one for aerial refuelling and another for reconnaissance, are flying over Iraqi airspace and have forced several civilian flights to alter their approach paths into Baghdad International. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Unidentified helicopter activity over Mosul as warplane flights continue across most Iraqi provinces
posts.summary: AMrym93884 reports unidentified rotary-wing flights over Mosul in tandem with intensive and continuous warplane activity over most Iraqi provinces. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iraqi MP al-Haidari pushes for Iraqi citizenship for Bahrainis stripped on Iran-sympathy grounds
posts.summary: AMrym93884 cites MP Alaa al-Haidari calling on the Iraqi government to grant Iraqi citizenship to every Bahraini whose nationality has been revoked over alleged sympathy with Iran. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Warplane noise reported over east Baghdad's al-Qanat district
posts.summary: AMrym93884 cites eyewitnesses to fighter-jet sound east of the canal in Baghdad on Saturday evening. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Sources say Rubio, Witkoff and Qatar PM Miami session focused on ending the Iran war and a separate sensitive Iraq file
posts.summary: AMrym93884 cites US sources that the Rubio, Witkoff and Qatari PM Mohammed bin Abdulrahman al-Thani meeting in Miami concentrated on closing the Iran war and on another serious matter related to Iraq. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: US warplane activity reported in Baghdad sky on Saturday evening
posts.summary: AMrym93884 reports US warplane overflight in Baghdad airspace at around the same time the civil-aviation reroute request was being processed. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Unusual US air activity tracked from Tel Aviv toward Iraq's southern border via the Samawah desert
posts.summary: AMrym93884 logs strange US air activity over the Samawah desert with US aircraft tracked outbound from Tel Aviv toward the southern Iraqi border. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: IRGC Aerospace commander says missiles and drones are locked on targets, awaiting launch order
posts.summary: AMrym93884 cites the IRGC Aerospace Force commander stating missiles and drones tied to the unit have been locked onto enemy targets and are awaiting the order to fire. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Wide US warship movements in the Sea of Oman flagged as potential prelude to a major operation
posts.summary: AMrym93884 flags broad US warship activity in the Sea of Oman, suggesting recent days were tests of Iranian naval capability whose findings will shape the US response. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iranian naval command warns any attack on Iranian tankers or commercial vessels will be met with a violent assault on US regional bases and ships
posts.summary: AMrym93884 quotes the Iranian naval command tweeting that any attack on Iranian oil tankers or commercial vessels will trigger a violent assault on a US regional base and on enemy ships. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Israeli media report the United States is preparing for a major operation in Iran
posts.summary: AMrym93884 cites Israeli media that Washington is readying a large-scale operation against Iran. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Oil portfolio still unsettled in Zaidi cabinet talks, Sudani coalition seen as the closest contender on the 25-point pricing
posts.summary: AMrym93884 reports that the Oil Ministry has not been resolved in the cabinet bargaining, with most Shia blocs eyeing the portfolio but the Sudani coalition closest to securing it because it can pay the 25-point price tag the slot now carries, similar to the presidency-level point allocation. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: WSJ-cited claim of an Israeli covert military site in Iraq's western desert allegedly used as the launchpad for strikes on Iran
posts.summary: AMrym93884 cites a Wall Street Journal report attributing to US officials that Israel set up a clandestine military site in the Iraqi desert from which operational support for the Iran air strikes was launched, with the IDF reportedly engaging Iraqi forces from the site at one point. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: MBS congratulatory cable to Zaidi follows a Kazimi-Saudi back-channel opened from Kazimi's Baghdad residence
posts.summary: AMrym93884 reports the Saudi Crown Prince's Saturday congratulatory cable to PM-designate al-Zaidi followed contacts run by former PM Mustafa al-Kazimi with the Saudi side after a morning meeting between Kazimi and Zaidi at Kazimi's home. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Full text of MBS cable congratulating Zaidi on his nomination as Iraqi Prime Minister
posts.summary: AMrym93884 publishes the full text of the cable from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to PM-designate Ali Faleh Kadhim al-Zaidi, expressing readiness to deepen brotherly relations across all fields and wishing Iraq and its people continued progress. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iraqi Health Ministry says no Hantavirus cases recorded inside Iraq, WHO global risk assessment is low
posts.summary: AMrym93884 cites the Iraqi Health Ministry spokesperson confirming no Hantavirus cases have been recorded in Iraq, with monitoring continuing across the global and regional epidemiological situation, scientific bulletins circulated to health departments, infection-control measures in place and the WHO assessing global risk as low. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Qatar-linked LNG carrier loaded at Ras Laffan begins outbound Hormuz crossing
posts.summary: Bacharelhalabi retweets staunovo flagging that a Qatar-linked liquefied natural gas carrier loaded at Ras Laffan earlier this month began its outbound journey on Saturday morning, a notable Hormuz transit datapoint inside the active force-majeure window.
